milestones.title: Initialize engine repository, CI and release workflow
scope: Create Node.js/TypeScript engine workspace with API, worker, SDK and shared UI package boundaries.
Configure lint, typecheck, test, formatting, dependency audit and reproducible lockfiles.
Publish versioned build artifacts through dry-run release automation.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Automated typecheck, lint, unit test, contract and package publish validation run on each PR.
verification: A fresh checkout installs and passes CI without secrets.
An intentionally failing test blocks merge and package publication.

milestones.title: Define canonical OpenAPI and generated engine SDK
scope: Define OpenAPI 3.1 specification for catalog, projects, assets, runs, workflows, approvals and usage.
Generate a typed TypeScript client and validated request/response contracts.
Establish SemVer policy, compatibility matrix and error code taxonomy.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Versioned API publishes valid schema and generated TS client with backward compatibility tests.
verification: Contract snapshot detects breaking changes.
Generated client calls a mocked API and rejects malformed data.

milestones.title: Implement OIDC authentication and product SSO
scope: Use OIDC authorization-code flow with PKCE, secure server sessions and product-specific audiences.
Implement sign-in, sign-out, session rotation, recovery boundaries and session revocation.
Expose identity endpoints used by both applications without granting provider credentials.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Academy and Command Center can open same account with appropriate session boundaries.
verification: Two mock apps use one identity while retaining audience-scoped sessions.
Session fixation, CSRF, expired-token and cross-app audience misuse tests fail closed.

milestones.title: Tenant roles, permissions and row-level isolation
scope: Implement organizations, workspaces, membership roles and explicit action/resource scopes.
Apply tenant isolation at API and PostgreSQL RLS boundaries with transaction-scoped claims.
Audit permission changes and protect service principal privileges.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Cross-tenant reads and writes are denied by API and database integration tests.
verification: Cross-tenant CRUD and artifact-link access are denied in API and SQL tests.
Role revocation immediately blocks previously allowed actions.

milestones.title: Neon database migrations, backups and dev branches
scope: Configure Neon pooled and migration connections, transactional migrations and migration CI.
Define tenant-safe base schema with indexes, referential integrity and migration ownership.
Document branch-based development, PITR backup checks and tested restore procedure.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Migrations and rollback guidance proven on ephemeral schema and backup recovery fixture.
verification: Migrate an empty database and a fixture with existing records.
Restore backup into isolated environment and verify records and schema.

milestones.title: Private object storage and controlled asset links
scope: Implement private S3-compatible blobs, tenant-scoped metadata, checksum and MIME validation.
Issue short-lived upload/download URLs and quarantine scanned uploads.
Enforce retention/deletion and deny implicit public exposure of generated media.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Direct cross-user asset access is denied; signed URLs expire and uploads are scanned.
verification: Expired or foreign-tenant links cannot retrieve assets.
Malicious upload fixture is quarantined and never delivered to editors.

milestones.title: Project/artifact version graph and export API
scope: Define canonical projects, typed artifacts, immutable revisions, edges, rights and provenance records.
Build create, browse, compare, export and non-destructive restore APIs with optimistic concurrency.
Persist structured source alongside binary media so both apps access identical version IDs.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Projects reopen with exact artifact history, typed links, hashes and export provenance.
verification: Create and revise multi-artifact project then reopen with exact lineage.
Concurrent edit collision returns explicit conflict without data loss.

milestones.title: Publish design tokens, domain UI package and base shell
scope: Publish shared design tokens and accessible primitives as a versioned UI package.
Implement domain workspace slots, panels, commands, controlled inputs and theme adapters.
Provide contract tests ensuring Academy and Command Center share tool behavior but not pedagogy.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Both applications render shared tool components from the same versioned package.
verification: Both thin example apps render the same domain component with different tokens.
Keyboard navigation and package version compatibility checks pass.

milestones.title: Tool manifest schema, UI anchors and domain plugin loader
scope: Specify versioned tool manifest JSON Schema, operation inputs, output artifacts and UI component IDs.
Register stable lesson-slot anchors without embedding teaching content in the engine.
Build trusted lazy domain plugin loader with permission and engine-version negotiation.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Schema validated; one tool is dynamically loaded and stable lesson slots are published.
verification: Load a signed sample domain tool with correct anchors and operation schema.
Reject incompatible plugin versions and invalid/unauthorized operations.

milestones.title: Model capability registry and provider health
scope: Create catalog taxonomy across generative, predictive, speech, vision, spatial, optimization and agent capabilities.
Store exact provider/model revisions, supported operations, modalities, regions, rights and pricing certainty.
Expose health/availability states and capability-based discovery instead of name-only vendor lists.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Catalog reports exact supported modalities, restrictions, pricing status and health.
verification: Unsupported or mislicensed model is never returned as available for that job.
Provider outage and unknown price are represented distinctly from healthy/known-priced.

milestones.title: Provider adapter SDK, credentials and secret handling
scope: Define streaming, async media and tool-call adapter interfaces with contract test harness.
Implement tenant-safe server-side credentials, rotation and redacted provider logs.
Test adapter limits, quotas, cancellation, rights reporting and provider-native options.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Provider-specific secrets remain server-side; at least two mock adapters pass conformance tests.
verification: Two independent fake providers pass the identical conformance suite.
Provider credentials and raw private prompts do not leak into browser bundles or logs.

milestones.title: Production text/reasoning provider and token streaming
scope: Integrate one approved live text/reasoning provider through capability routing.
Stream partial output and create immutable text artifacts under authenticated projects.
Persist actual provider response usage, model revision and error state after budget authorization.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated text generation streams and persists with actual provider usage records.
verification: Live authorized call streams then survives page refresh as a stored version.
Interrupted or rejected request settles ledger correctly and cannot exceed its cap.

milestones.title: Structured generation, retrieval and approved tool calls
scope: Add JSON Schema-constrained structured outputs and fail-closed parsing.
Implement cited retrieval with source identifiers, confidence/coverage warnings and citation validation.
Permit only separately authorized tool calls from generated workflows or text agents.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Validated structured outputs, citations and tool scope enforcement are demonstrated.
verification: Malformed structure never reaches downstream writer.
Prompt-injection test document cannot confer extra tool privileges.

milestones.title: Budget estimation, reservation and usage ledger
scope: Build rate-card estimators and integer-unit wallets, grants, reserve, charge, release and refunds.
Reserve budget atomically before dispatch with per-run, tenant and global hard limits.
Reconcile duplicate, partial and delayed usage with provider invoices/records.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Concurrent requests cannot overspend hard caps; actual provider usage reconciles.
verification: Parallel debit attempts cannot overspend the same account.
Retry and callback replay never double-charge a logical provider task.

milestones.title: Typed workflow template engine and graph validation
scope: Implement typed workflow recipe/version format with node inputs, outputs and artifact references.
Validate DAG topology, policy gates, incompatible formats, cost ceilings and conditional branches.
Compile deliverable checklists into previewable plans with required human approvals.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Cycles and invalid artifact bindings are rejected; goal checklists instantiate valid DAGs.
verification: Reject cycles and wrong artifact types with understandable diagnostics.
Legislative/film goal selections produce valid dependency graphs.

milestones.title: Durable worker queue, outbox, retries and checkpoints
scope: Implement transactional outbox, leased durable PostgreSQL job queue and worker process.
Persist attempt IDs, idempotency keys, checkpoints, retry classes and dead-letter events.
Schedule ready DAG nodes with concurrency constraints and avoid repeated billable requests after crashes.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Crash and restart safely resumes jobs and avoids duplicate external billable dispatch.
verification: Kill worker between reserve and provider acknowledgment then recover safely.
Concurrent workers cannot claim the same job twice.

milestones.title: Streaming run states, cancellation and retry controls
scope: Define append-only run events and authenticated SSE stream with cursor/replay support.
Expose explicit states, partial outputs, user cancellation, idempotent retry and honest provider cancel limitations.
Build reusable progress and job inspection SDK helpers.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: SSE progress, partial output, cancel and retry work even after page refresh.
verification: Reopen browser and reattach to ongoing/finished run with complete event history.
Cancel/retry transitions do not create invalid state or duplicate billable executions.

milestones.title: Signed provider callbacks and asynchronous media lifecycle
scope: Build async submission/status/polling lifecycle for image, music and video providers.
Verify provider webhook signatures, timestamps and idempotent callback IDs.
Deduplicate out-of-order completion events and settle output assets, rights and charges once.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate/out-of-order callbacks reconcile to one terminal result and charge.
verification: Replay identical callback and send terminal state before progress callback.
Provider task and user budget reconcile to one final result despite restarts.

milestones.title: Restricted MCP tools and resource connectors
scope: Integrate MCP resource/tool clients through explicit allowlists and expiring user consent grants.
Validate tool arguments and results, defend against injected instructions and control network egress.
Record tool authority, approvals, inputs and effects in tamper-evident run audit.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Scope allowlists, user consent and injection tests pass for tool access.
verification: Injected retrieved page cannot request forbidden file/secret export.
Revoking grant blocks later tool invocation and returns a clear error.

milestones.title: A2A external-agent boundary and delegated task audit
scope: Implement A2A delegation with agent capability discovery and authenticated scoped tasks.
Pass only least-privilege context with budgets, deadlines and data retention restrictions.
Record remote task IDs, outputs, cancellation and approval chain into run provenance.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Remote agent delegation is traced, bounded by permissions and cancellable.
verification: Delegated worker cannot access a broader tool scope than caller.
Timeout/cancel/replay handling leaves a complete auditable trail.

milestones.title: Research, citations and document generation workspace
scope: Build research collection, source inspector, deduplication, cited notes and document composer.
Integrate allowed research/retrieval connectors with attribution and freshness metadata.
Export editable research report with source appendix and rights/source warnings.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Editable cited report with source inventory and structured export.
verification: Open cited passage from report to exact saved source record.
Reopen/edit/export report without losing citations or source history.

milestones.title: Distinct poetry, persuasion and fiction editors
scope: Create dedicated poetry editor with stanza/line, meter and sound tools.
Create separate persuasion editor with audience, claims, evidence, objections and revision tracks.
Add fiction workspace with scenes, characters and continuity references sharing artifact versioning.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Three distinct task UIs save portable editable artifacts and shared revision history.
verification: Three workspace UIs visibly differ and save meaningful structured text.
A poem, argument draft and fictional scene round-trip independently across both apps.

milestones.title: Structured legislation editor and package DAG
scope: Implement bill editor with sections, definitions, amendments and jurisdiction/source fields.
Provide configurable package checklist for bill, analysis, one-pager, talking points and source appendix.
Generate linked artifacts through reviewed DAG, preserving editable drafts and verifiable cited sources.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Checkbox-generated bill/package yields linked, individually editable draft outputs.
verification: Selecting bill plus explanatory outputs instantiates correct editable versions.
Unverified jurisdiction or legal assertions are visibly flagged, never silently certified.

milestones.title: Image board, masking and variation workspace
scope: Build prompt/reference board, image generation, variation comparison and asset picker.
Implement editable region masks and round-trip masking to real supported provider edit APIs.
Track image lineage, dimensions, licensed usage options and non-destructive revisions.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Live image provider generation plus canvas edits/versioning/rights metadata work.
verification: A live provider generates and masks an image with results saved as linked versions.
Unsupported edit option is disabled rather than presented as operational.

milestones.title: Music creation and compare workspace
scope: Build minimalist music prompt/style/lyrics and model-native control workspace.
Connect one licensed music-generation provider with real audio preview, variations and compare.
Persist rights metadata, audio format, duration, cost and generation provenance.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Live licensed music provider can generate, preview and save real music assets.
verification: Create two live candidate tracks, compare and export owned/authorized asset.
Commercial-rights restrictions are shown before generating rather than assumed.

milestones.title: Music sections, stems and multitrack project model
scope: Implement beat/bar-aware arrangement timeline, clips, tracks and section revisions.
Integrate only actually supported stem separation and track/section operations.
Support nondestructive editing, stems, versioned remix/export and timing metadata.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Supported edit operations preserve section timecodes, track provenance and reusable stems.
verification: Separated stems align against original playback within defined tolerance.
Unsupported MIDI/track regeneration features are reported unavailable.

milestones.title: Video storyboard, timeline and production workspace
scope: Build screenplay-to-shot breakdown, storyboard/reference and shot continuity tool.
Integrate licensed video generation/render jobs with timeline assembly, trim and output pipeline.
Manage scene versions, soundtrack synchronization, review checkpoints and deliverable packaging.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Generate/sequence scenes and export actual video output with project metadata.
verification: Generate real shots and export one playably encoded composite clip.
Failed shot regenerates without rerunning unrelated screenplay and audio nodes.

milestones.title: Voice, transcription, sound and captions workspace
scope: Implement transcription, diarization, aligned captions and speech synthesis workspaces.
Support voice/likeness permissions, multilingual dubbing where provider actually supports it.
Create versioned voice/sound artifacts with timecodes and caption export.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Transcribe and generate licensed voice assets and time-aligned captions.
verification: Transcribe and caption real audio with verified alignment fixture.
Unconsented voice-cloning operation is blocked and logged.

milestones.title: Monaco IDE shell, filesystem and editor experience
scope: Build Monaco workspace with project tree, multi-file editing, search, diffs and checkpoints.
Connect persistent project snapshots to isolated terminal sessions and saved workspace preferences.
Provide code export/import and conflict-safe revision history shared by both apps.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: File tree, search, editor, diff, terminal and source export operate on persistent workspaces.
verification: Edit multi-file project, run terminal command and restore version across sessions.
Two simultaneous edits yield explicit resolved changes rather than silent overwrites.

milestones.title: Isolated multi-language sandbox, LSP and code agent
scope: Create sandbox broker isolated from API and platform secrets with CPU/RAM/time/egress budgets.
Implement JS/TS and Python runtimes, terminal streaming, dependency installation and LSP service.
Offer code-agent patch proposals and execution only within authorized ephemeral workspace.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: At minimum JS/TS and Python execute securely; runtime matrix tests other languages as enabled.
verification: Run JS/TS and Python tests without access to engine credentials or host network.
Timeout, process escape and malicious package fixtures are contained and audited.

milestones.title: Backend previews, test runner, GitHub and dev database
scope: Add full-stack multi-process preview and safe forwarded preview URL with authentication.
Integrate test runner, GitHub import/commit/branch operations and isolated development database branch.
Supply repeatable project template for frontend plus API with logs and health probes.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Two-service app runs preview with tests, Git commit and isolated database integration.
verification: Boot two-service demo with working API, frontend, test and database.
Git commit and preview persist without exposing another user's running process.

milestones.title: Scoped deployment connectors and approval process
scope: Implement deployment credential broker for approved external hosts and target namespaces.
Show target, repo, diff, environment, blast radius and cost implications before external writes.
Record scoped approval receipt, deploy state, rollback and audit events.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Never deploy/write external systems without explicit target- and consequence-specific approval.
verification: No deployment occurs without actual target-specific approval.
A revoked/expired approval cannot be replayed to deploy.

milestones.title: Data-analysis, SQL and reproducible notebooks
scope: Build SQL, CSV/parquet import, data notebook cells and chart workspace.
Execute Python and SQL in tenant-isolated reproducible environments with constrained datasets.
Track source lineage, versions, parameterized computations and export artifacts.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Data import, repeatable cells, charts, notebooks and source lineage persist.
verification: Re-executing a frozen notebook generates consistent outputs.
Unknown tenant dataset and unauthorized query are rejected.

milestones.title: Agent automation visual builder and approval gates
scope: Build visual agent workflow editor with typed triggers, branches, loops bounded by explicit budgets.
Add human approval gates, scheduling policy, pause/resume, failure routing and audit view.
Persist versioned recipe and execution history independent of open browser tabs.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Run graph has triggers/conditions, deterministic audit log and halt/retry semantics.
verification: Rebuild multi-step workflow from saved recipe and pause on approval.
A denied high-impact action cannot be silently retried with elevated scope.

milestones.title: Cross-media conversions, package export and provenance
scope: Implement artifact transformation graph for source text, image, audio, video, data and export bundles.
Track format support, source rights, lossy conversion warnings and exact provenance.
Produce signed portable project/export manifests including revision relationships.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Source-to-target conversions produce versioned artifacts with rights and parent links.
verification: Export mixed-media project and verify manifest references/hashes.
Converting an unsupported source fails without fabricating an output.

milestones.title: Threat model, upload/sandbox/agent security hardening
scope: Document threat model for uploaded content, prompt injection, isolation, delegated agents and billing abuse.
Add attack fixtures, mandatory scans, secret rotation guidance, tenant privacy and CSP hardening.
Require independent security review and explicit high-impact operation authorization.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: SSRF, prompt-injection, escaped container, exfiltration and tenant isolation suites pass.
verification: Cross-tenant, SSRF, injection, exfiltration and sandbox-escape suites pass.
Threat mitigations are documented with reproduced negative tests.

milestones.title: Performance, pricing, concurrency and recovery trials
scope: Perform realistic provider concurrency, job recovery, API and UI load testing.
Run atomic ledger race, webhook replay, service restart and full backup restore drills.
Publish SLOs, capacity estimates, price stress bounds and incident exercise report.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Load tests, cost race conditions, webhook replay and backup restore complete.
verification: Document tested throughput/latency and cost budget at load.
A deliberate failure and restore exercise meets stated recovery objective.

milestones.title: Unified OpenTelemetry dashboards, alerts and status
scope: Instrument API, worker, provider adapter, storage and ledger with OpenTelemetry.
Expose health/readiness, source version, alerts for latency/error/spend and job dead-letter.
Produce internal support view and privacy-preserving incident correlation.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Core API/worker/provider errors and spend anomalies surface actionable alerts.
verification: Simulated provider outage and quota anomaly trigger actionable alerts.
Trace correlates request to worker and settled billing without exposing secrets.

milestones.title: Production deployment and acceptance evidence
scope: Deploy engine API and durable worker to authorized production targets with migration and secret checks.
Verify exact commit, health/readiness, live provider request, signed callback and storage persistence.
Record rollback procedure, security acceptance, backup evidence and deployment ownership.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: End-to-end live acceptance and correct source SHA verified before labeling complete.
verification: Public smoke and authenticated full lifecycle pass on deployed SHA.
No production signoff if backup, cost controls or alerting evidence is absent.

milestones.title: Extension developer kit and adapter certification
scope: Publish versioned provider/domain plugin authoring kit with examples, schemas and test fixtures.
Require adapter conformance for rights, costs, credentials, retries, limits and data policy.
Provide certification workflow and extension compatibility registry for new AI families.
milestones.acceptanceCriteria: Third-party adapter passes contract/license/quotas/security conformance suite.
verification: A third-party sample adapter passes conformance with no privileged core access.
A broken/unsupported plugin is refused with precise diagnostics.
